title: Long-Term Clinical Outcomes of nDSAEK and Machine Learning-Based Prediction of Graft Survival in Corneal Endothelial Decompensation

indication: Corneal endothelial decompensation treated with non-Descemet-stripping automated endothelial keratoplasty (nDSAEK): Fuchs endothelial corneal dystrophy with bullous changes (43 eyes) or decompensation after previous ocular surgery, mostly cataract surgery (71 eyes); young donors (12-30 years) from the institutional eye bank; microkeratome or femtosecond-laser graft preparation; single surgeon

groups.indication: Fuchs endothelial corneal dystrophy with bullous changes
groups.description: nDSAEK (host Descemet membrane not stripped; 7.5-8.0 mm posterior lamellar graft by microkeratome or femtosecond laser, glide insertion, air tamponade) in FECD eyes

groups.indication: Endothelial decompensation secondary to previous ocular surgery (cataract surgery, including some with trauma surgery, vitrectomy or a previous graft)
groups.description: nDSAEK (host Descemet membrane not stripped; 7.5-8.0 mm posterior lamellar graft by microkeratome or femtosecond laser, glide insertion, air tamponade) in non-FECD eyes

series.baseline_label: Table 1 row 'Preoperative' = the recipient's own preoperative ECD (Results: preoperative ECD could not be recorded in several eyes because of severe corneal edema), not the donor ECD; it is the reference of the article's 3-year cumulative ECD loss
series.notes: Table 1 'ECD (cell/mm2)' FECD column; mean ± SD (Methods: continuous variables as mean ± standard deviation). Series n omitted: the number of eyes with a recorded preoperative ECD is not reported (group size 43). Per-visit n not tabulated; median follow-up 41.5 months.

series.baseline_label: Table 1 row 'Preoperative' = the recipient's own preoperative ECD (Results: preoperative ECD could not be recorded in several eyes because of severe corneal edema), not the donor ECD; it is the reference of the article's 3-year cumulative ECD loss
series.notes: Table 1 'ECD (cell/mm2)' Non-FECD column; mean ± SD (Methods: continuous variables as mean ± standard deviation). Series n omitted: the number of eyes with a recorded preoperative ECD is not reported (group size 71). Per-visit n not tabulated; median follow-up 41.5 months.

exclusions.reason: The same table gives absolute ECD for both groups; the absolute ECD series are used

exclusions.what: Table 1 P columns and the Mean CCT columns
exclusions.reason: p-values are not admissible; CCT is not endothelial cell density
Values of other studies and graft survival rates, not ECD of this cohort

exclusions.what: Linear mixed-model ECD estimates and femtosecond versus manual comparison (Results text, Figure 10)
exclusions.reason: Model estimates in text/figures, not tabulated group means

notes: Keratoplasty study whose tabulated reference is the recipient's diseased cornea, not the donor: kept because it is the article's stated reference row for the follow-up loss, as the extraction brief allows; reference_kind is patient_preoperative and this mismatch must be considered before any use as a donor-referenced series.
FECD and non-FECD are patient-condition subgroups after the same standard procedure: control-role groups.

Both microkeratome and femtosecond-laser graft preparation are pooled within each group; 15 graft failures occurred during follow-up and the article does not state whether failed grafts contribute to later ECD means.
